findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/ContMDiff/Atlas.lean` as public `IsManifold.maximalAtlas_subset_of_contMDiff_id`, add the companion `IsManifold.maximalAtlas_eq_of_contMDiff_id`, inline the trivial `contMDiffOn_comp_pair`, and derive `IsSubmersion.maximalAtlas_eq` from them.

summary: A general maximal-atlas comparison lemma is hidden as `private` in the submersion file, and the new public surjectivity lemma duplicates an existing private one under a different name instead of exposing the canonical declaration.
